evidence.detail: rs/y accepts and returns rs/d/a[]; R28 identifies rs/d/a as SequenceDefinition.
Its default loader opens the hard-coded config path configs/old_a.dat.
The loader clones the incoming SequenceDefinition array, parses sections introduced by the literal "anim", and rewrites sequence arrays/fields from arr1:, arr2: and other: records.

candidates.note: LegacySequenceConfigLoader is the conservative semantic name for the exact old_a.dat SequenceDefinition override loader.

evidence.detail: rs/z accepts and returns rs/d/x[]; R28 identifies rs/d/x as SpotAnimationDefinition.
Its reader opens the hard-coded legacy graphic config path configs/old_g.dat beneath the client data root.

The file format uses "graphic", "data:", "arr1:" and "arr2:" records to overwrite SpotAnimationDefinition model/sequence/scale/rotation/light/recolor-related fields, and rebinds the linked SequenceDefinition.

candidates.note: LegacySpotAnimationConfigLoader is the conservative semantic name for the exact old_g.dat SpotAnimationDefinition override loader.
